claim: Foot signs appear 'long before any blood test catches the problem' (diabetes)
source: NIDDK Diabetic Neuropathy https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/diabetes/overview/preventing-problems/nerve-damage-diabetic-neuropathies ; Baylor Medicine (neuropathy ~8-10 y after onset) https://www.bcm.edu/healthcare/specialties/neurology/neuromuscular-diseases/conditions/diabetic-neuropathy ; ADA Standards of Care 2026 screening (A1C/FPG from age 35) https://diabetesjournals.org/care/article/49/Supplement_1/S6/163930/Summary-of-Revisions-Standards-of-Care-in-Diabetes
source_type: Government health agency + academic medical center + professional guideline
safe_reframing: Foot changes can appear in people who have had high blood sugar for years; an A1C blood test is how diabetes is actually found - usually years earlier than nerve damage.

claim: '9 Foot Signs of Hidden Diabetes' (title) - foot signs as diagnostic of hidden diabetes
appears_in: CJxCjygEnmo title; copied by >=6 external mills (C03)
source: NIDDK (neuropathy symptoms: numbness, tingling, burning; sores/ulcers from lost feeling) - these are complications seen IN diabetes, not validated diagnostic signs
safe_reframing: 'Foot changes that can come with long-term high blood sugar - and what to ask your doctor to test'.

claim: Clove + coffee: 'What happens 10 minutes later' / script: 'in the first 15 minutes... energy without the jitters... eugenol relaxes blood vessels'
source: Banner Health clove water review https://www.bannerhealth.com/healthcareblog/advise-me/the-benefits-and-risks-of-drinking-clove-water ; Noom evidence summary https://www.noom.com/blog/weight-management/clove-water-for-weight-loss/ (evidence is from concentrated extracts/preliminary studies, not culinary clove water)
safe_reframing: No study shows a 10- or 15-minute effect. Safe: 'What cloves actually contain, what the research on concentrated extracts shows, and why a cup of clove coffee is flavour, not medicine'. Note title (10 min) and script (15 min) disagree.

claim: 'Eugenol is a natural anti-inflammatory that works stronger than ibuprofen in some studies'
source: No human trial at culinary dose located this session; evidence summaries above describe lab/extract studies only
safe_reframing: Do not compare a spice to a drug. Say 'lab studies suggest eugenol has anti-inflammatory activity; that has not been shown in people drinking clove coffee'.

claim: Clove coffee: 'within 3 days blood sugar stabilizes... eugenol improves insulin receptor sensitivity'; 'within 1 month... cleaner liver'
source: Same evidence summaries (scarce human data)
safe_reframing: Remove dated benefit ladders. Blood-sugar claims require diabetes-care framing and a clinician referral.

claim: Clove/eugenol + blood thinners (warfarin, aspirin): talk to a doctor first
appears_in: KPigGh9_gbU transcript (contraindication segment); 1xLJ3ZsDt38 (SHH 'STOP using cloves with these medications')
source: Drugs.com clove-warfarin interaction https://www.drugs.com/drug-interactions/clove-with-warfarin-2548-0-2311-0.html ; PubMed alternative therapies & warfarin https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10902065/
safe_reframing: Keep: 'large amounts of clove, especially oil or extracts, may add to bleeding risk with blood thinners - ask your pharmacist'.

claim: 'Up to 12 kg of waste inside your body' / '5 KG of stool out in 1 hour' / 'Flush 10 lbs in 1 min' / '1 cup = total cleanse'
source: Mayo Clinic 'Colon cleansing: Is it helpful or harmful?' https://www.mayoclinic.org/healthy-lifestyle/consumer-health/expert-answers/colon-cleansing/faq-20058435
safe_reframing: 'Constipation after 60: what actually helps (fiber, fluids, movement, medication review) and why colon cleanses are not recommended'.

claim: 'This fruit repairs eyes overnight - cataracts' (thumbnail)
source: American Academy of Ophthalmology nutrition review https://www.aao.org/eyenet/article/nutrition-in-fight-against-eye-disease ; NEI AREDS/AREDS2 https://www.nei.nih.gov/eye-health-information/clinical-trials/age-related-eye-disease-studies-aredsareds2/about-areds-and-areds2 (AREDS supplements had no effect on cataract)
safe_reframing: 'Foods linked with eye health (leafy greens: lutein/zeaxanthin) - and what diet cannot do for cataracts'.

claim: 'This 1 vegetable heals dead kidneys (lower creatinine fast)' / 'lower creatinine overnight'
appears_in: Thumbnail #95 (Okoro), #63 (Ares); GT-14 rising 'how to lower creatinine overnight'
source: National Kidney Foundation creatinine https://www.kidney.org/kidney-topics/creatinine ; American Kidney Fund superfood trap https://www.kidneyfund.org/article/avoid-superfood-trap-tips-improve-your-creatinine-and-egfr
safe_reframing: 'What your creatinine number means, why no food heals kidneys overnight, and what actually protects kidney function (BP, sugar control, medication review)'.

claim: 'This sleeping position increases STROKE risk overnight'
source: American Heart Association 'Can sleep position affect your heart and brain health?' https://www.heart.org/en/news/2025/01/24/can-sleep-position-affect-your-heart-and-brain-health
safe_reframing: 'Back-sleeping can worsen sleep apnea - and untreated sleep apnea raises stroke risk'. No evidence that position alone causes stroke in healthy people.

claim: 'The most dangerous time to take blood pressure medication' / 'NEVER take BP pills at this time'
source: TIME trial, Lancet 2022 https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(22)01786-X/fulltext (evening vs morning: no difference in major CV outcomes; take at a convenient consistent time)
safe_reframing: 'Morning or night for BP pills? The 21,000-person TIME trial found no difference - consistency and side-effect timing matter more'.

claim: 'One of them could drop your blood pressure so fast you'll hit the floor before you reach the bathroom'
source: JAMDA meta-analysis orthostatic hypotension and falls https://www.jamda.com/article/S1525-8610(18)30635-2/abstract ; AHA Hypertension class-effects study https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/10.1161/hypertensionaha.119.13445 (no long-term class difference in falls/syncope)
safe_reframing: Orthostatic dizziness is real and linked to falls; say 'stand up slowly, report dizziness', not 'this pill will make you hit the floor'.

claim: '9 popular medications that can trigger RAPID dementia' / 'medications that cause dementia'
source: AGS Beers Criteria (anticholinergic burden -> cognitive decline, delirium, falls) https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/articles/24946-beers-criteria
safe_reframing: 'Medicines on the Beers list that can affect memory in older adults - review them with your pharmacist' (drop 'rapid dementia').

claim: Exercise/balance training prevents falls
source: Cochrane review Sherrington 2019 https://www.cochranelibrary.com/cdsr/doi/10.1002/14651858.CD012424.pub2/full (exercise reduces rate of falls 23%, high certainty); CDC falls facts https://www.cdc.gov/falls/data-research/facts-stats/index.html
safe_reframing: Keep. Frame a single walking cue as one part of balance training, not a life-saving guarantee.

claim: 'One SIMPLE change to how you walk could save your life after 70'
source: Cochrane 2019 supports multi-component exercise programs, not one gait cue
safe_reframing: 'The walking habit physical therapists check first - and the balance exercises proven to cut falls'.

claim: 'The ONLY 6 exercises you need to relieve neuropathy in feet & legs'
source: PMC meta-analysis exercise in DPN https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10065320/ (balance improved; no clear effect on fall risk); BMC Neuroscience RCT https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12868-024-00924-6
safe_reframing: 'Seated exercises that can improve balance and symptom comfort with neuropathy' - drop 'only' and 'relieve' as a cure promise.

claim: 'The REAL reason you wake up to pee at night - it's not your bladder'
source: Sleep Foundation nocturia https://www.sleepfoundation.org/physical-health/nocturia-or-frequent-unrination-night (nocturnal polyuria may be the most common cause; evening fluid/caffeine limits advised)
source_type: Health information publisher citing clinical literature
safe_reframing: 'Often it's how much urine your body makes at night, not bladder size - and when to get checked (prostate, diabetes, heart, sleep apnea)'.

claim: Seniors need to bathe only 2-3 times per week; short warm showers
source: American Academy of Dermatology guidance as reported by StudyFinds https://studyfinds.com/how-often-should-seniors-shower-experts-say-daily-too-much/ and Medical News Today https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/324682 (secondary sources)
safe_reframing: 'Most older adults don't need a full bath daily - dry skin is the reason; daily washing of key areas still matters'.

claim: 'Stanford study: wall-assisted mini squat cut knee pain 64% in 137 adults aged 70-88'; 'Johns Hopkins 2022, 1,100 adults'
source: Search for the cited Stanford trial found no matching study (closest: Saudi Arabia isometric wall-squat RCT https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41381113/)
safe_reframing: Never cite a study that cannot be linked. Use Cochrane/RCT sources with URLs in the description.

claim: 'Add THIS to your coffee - stem cells reactivate, cancer starves, fat burns'
appears_in: 1KEvPjIZVsU (Elias 1.3K); HWP 'This ONE Food Regrows Stem Cells & STARVES Cancer'
source: No supporting human evidence found; extraordinary cancer claim
safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE.

claim: 'World's No.1 heart surgeon: Walking won't save you / STOP WALKING'
source: CDC falls/physical-activity guidance; Cochrane 2019 (walking-inclusive exercise programs)
safe_reframing: DO_NOT_USE. Acceptable contrarian: 'walking alone may not build leg strength - add these strength moves' (TopHealthTips 800K shows the accurate version works).

claim: 'Never eat this fish - it shortens your life' (salmon shown)
source: American Heart Association fish twice weekly https://www.heart.org/en/news/2018/05/25/eating-fish-twice-a-week-reduces-heart-stroke-risk
safe_reframing: 'Which fish to limit (high-mercury) vs which to eat twice a week' - never show salmon as the villain.

claim: Supplement-drug interactions (e.g., turmeric with statins/BP tablets)
source: Clove-warfarin interaction evidence (MV-06) as model; turmeric-specific source not fetched this session
safe_reframing: 'Supplements to check with your pharmacist if you take blood thinners, statins or BP tablets'.

claim: Oral semaglutide (Wegovy pill) availability for older adults
source: Novo Nordisk FDA approval announcement (Dec 22, 2025) https://www.novonordisk.com/content/nncorp/global/en/news-and-media/news-and-ir-materials/news-details.html?id=916472 ; AJMC https://www.ajmc.com/view/fda-approves-oral-semaglutide-as-first-glp-1-pill-for-weight-loss
source_type: Manufacturer + trade press on FDA action
safe_reframing: Only factual status + 'questions to ask your doctor'; no dosing advice.
